meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用浏览器打开网页、点击、填表、截图、提取数据、测试页面，并读取页面标题、链接等信息。
howto.when: 当需要浏览网页、查资料、操作网页应用、填表、截图或测试页面时触发；即使你没明说，只要浏览器派得上用场，Claude 也会主动用。

say.text: 帮我把这个网页存成 PDF
打开登录页，帮我填用户名和密码并登录
say.note: Claude 会按步骤填写并提交表单。

say.text: 把这个页面上所有链接提取出来
say.note: Claude 会获取页面元素并列出链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use a browser to open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, test pages, and read page titles, links, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when browsing, researching, interacting with web apps, filling forms, taking screenshots, or testing pages is needed; even without an explicit request, if a browser would help, Claude uses it.

say_en.text: Save this webpage as a PDF
say_en.note: Claude opens the page and generates a PDF.

say_en.text: Open the login page, fill in username and password, and log in
say_en.note: Claude fills and submits the form step by step.

say_en.text: Extract all links from this page
say_en.note: Claude gets elements and lists the links.
